title: The TRICURE EU Pivotal Study
official: The TRICURE EU PIVOTAL TRiCares Topaz Transcatheter TRICUspid Heart Valve REplacement System EUropean PIVOTAL Study
summary: Prospective, multi-center study to assess safety and performance of the TRiCares Topaz Tricuspid Valve Replacement System
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients
* Tricuspid regurgitation grade 3 (severe) on a scale of 0 (none) to 5 (torrential)
* Institutional Heart Team evaluates patient as being at increased operative risk

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient in need of emergent intervention
* Patient who is hemodynamically unstable
* Anatomical contraindications for implantation with study device
* Patient who is currently participating in another clinical investigation where the primary endpoint was not reached yet

sites.f: University Medical Center of the Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz
